entries.id: native:[Every colony's start is measured on the finished map, and a model fitted to thousands of games between equal opponents turns those measurements into a fitness. The fitness says how likely that colony is to win. Fairness is how evenly those chances are shared: 1 when every colony is as likely to win as any other, 0 when one colony would take the map.]
entries.key: [Every colony's start is measured on the finished map, and a model fitted to thousands of games between equal opponents turns those measurements into a fitness. The fitness says how likely that colony is to win. Fairness is how evenly those chances are shared: 1 when every colony is as likely to win as any other, 0 when one colony would take the map.]
entries.source: Every colony's start is measured on the finished map, and a model fitted to thousands of games between equal opponents turns those measurements into a fitness. The fitness says how likely that colony is to win. Fairness is how evenly those chances are shared: 1 when every colony is as likely to win as any other, 0 when one colony would take the map.
entries.target: วัด​จุดเริ่มต้น​ของ​ทุก​อาณานิคม​จาก​แผนที่​ที่​สร้าง​เสร็จ แบบจำลอง​ที่​ฝึก​จาก​เกม​นับ​พัน​ระหว่าง​คู่แข่ง​ฝีมือ​เท่ากัน​แปลง​ผลวัด​เป็น​คะแนน​ความเหมาะสม คะแนน​บอก​โอกาส​ชนะ​ของ​อาณานิคม ความเป็นธรรม​บอก​ความ​เท่าเทียม​ของ​โอกาส: 1 เมื่อ​ทุก​อาณานิคม​มี​โอกาส​ชนะ​เท่ากัน และ 0 เมื่อ​อาณานิคม​เดียว​มี​โอกาส​ชนะ​ทั้งหมด
